◆ Read of the market

Launch a plant-based cookie.

Cookies are the largest category ($13.0B, 25.8% of the market) and still growing at 6.3% a year — yet only 8% of cookie revenue is plant-based. Every other big category has already been colonized: crackers are 76% plant-based, chips 80%. Cookies are the one large, growing, high-per-SKU category where the plant-based shelf is nearly empty. The white space is a sweet, indulgent, plant-based cookie brand.
